purpose: Validates the C-1 routing-independence fix (2026-09-24 code audit) on the 150-case dev sample before committing to the full test-set re-run.

old_circular.description: rule label vs. RAG prediction classified over rule-boosted retrieval (query_rerank_and_boost) - the original T026 measurement, later found circular.

new_decoupled.description: rule label vs. a fresh classification over plain, non-rule-boosted retrieval (query_and_rerank) - the fix.

conclusion: The decoupled signal survives essentially unchanged. C-1 (rule used twice, once in retrieval and once in routing) is a real methodology finding, but was not measurably inflating the reported AUROC/coverage/selective-accuracy numbers on this sample. Cleared to proceed with the corrected pipeline (pipeline/orchestrator.py) for the full T041 re-run.
